concept: Pushing away from generic 'gold and maroon' Indian jewelry sites. Radha Imitation Jewellery becomes a contemporary, high-fashion editorial archive. It contrasts the intricate, ornate details of Kundan and Temple jewelry against stark, ultra-minimalist geometric grids and oversized serif typography.

headings.usage_rules: Use for Hero H1, section titles, and quote blocks. Always use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter) for massive sizes (text-5xl to text-6xl+). Never use Inter/Roboto.

body.usage_rules: Use for all UI text, product descriptions, admin dashboard data, and buttons. Adds a contemporary sterile contrast to the ornate serif.

colors.strategy: High-Contrast Editorial (Monochrome Canvas to let gold/jewels pop)
rules: NO traditional maroon or solid gold background colors.
Use #0A0B0A (Obsidian) for buttons and primary CTAs.
Admin Dashboard: Strictly monochrome, color is ONLY for status (Green for Delivered, Red for Cancelled, etc).

visual_enhancers.signature_motif: The Archive Grid & The Razor Arch. Use 1px sharp borders to separate content blocks (like a physical museum glass case). Use SVG Arch shapes as image masks to hint at Indian palace architecture but modernized as a razor-sharp vector.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: No drop shadows. Use 1px solid borders for separation. For sticky headers, use Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F9F6]/80 border-b border-black/10).
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle SVG noise/grain overlay on full page background to kill digital flatness.

storefront.spacing: Generous. p-8, p-16, gap-12. Allow massive negative space around product images.

admin_dashboard.style: Technical/Swiss Brutalist. Grid borders visible (border-collapse style).

storefront.navbar: Glassmorphism sticky header. Massive Bodoni Moda logo centered. Mega-menu expands as a full-width brutalist dropdown (solid #F9F9F6 background, no transparency) with 1px borders dividing the 3 categories.
storefront.hero: Editorial layout. Large asymmetrical image of model on the right (max-h-[80vh]), massive Bodoni Moda typography overlapping slightly on the left. Parallax scroll effect.
storefront.product_card: No borders, no background. Just the image (which reveals a second image on hover), Bodoni Moda title, and General Sans price. 'Add to Cart' appears on hover as a sharp black pill button.
storefront.filters_sidebar: Sticky left column. Accordions for subcategories. Checkboxes use custom sharp square styling.
storefront.cart_drawer: Slides from right. Monochromatic, displaying line-items, subtotal, and a brutalist progress bar for free shipping.

admin_dashboard.sidebar: Dark mode (#0A0B0A) with white General Sans text. Minimalist icons.
admin_dashboard.kpi_cards: No radius (rounded-none), 1px solid border, huge numbers in Bodoni Moda.
admin_dashboard.data_tables: Dense, zebra-striping disabled, bottom borders only. Status pills are sharp rectangles.
admin_dashboard.forms: Product CRUD uses Shadcn inputs but radius set to 0. 1px black borders on focus.

effects: Staggered fade-up reveals for grids (Products, Collections).
Image parallax inside containers (scale 1.1 to 1.0 on scroll).
Hover: Images swap or zoom slowly. Buttons invert colors (black to white).

hero_editorial.description: Portrait of a woman in traditional jewelry and attire, showcasing elegance and style outdoors.
hero_editorial.usage: Storefront Hero Background / Main Featured Image

category_necklaces.description: woman leaning on stair rails with heavy necklace

category_earrings.description: Detailed close-up of traditional silver jewelry with intricate designs from Dhaka, Bangladesh.

editorial_fashion.description: Stunning close-up portrait of an elegant woman wearing exquisite jewelry.

accessibility.contrast: All text must meet APCA/WCAG AA standards. Ensure gray text (#5C615E) has enough contrast against #F9F9F6.
accessibility.focus: All interactive elements must have a sharp 2px black outline on focus (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-black focus:ring-offset-2).
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Disable parallax and fast transitions for these users.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required dependencies: framer-motion, @phosphor-icons/react (or lucide-react), lenis.
Since this is Vite React (.js), use standard JSX/JS syntax. Do not output TypeScript (.tsx) files.
CRITICAL: Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for the mega-menu or any dropdown. It must have a solid background (#F9F9F6).
CRITICAL: Every button, link, and form input MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-shop-now-btn').
Implement Shadcn UI for the Admin Dashboard and customize it to have sharp corners (radius: 0) and high-contrast borders.
For the Storefront, rely heavily on raw HTML/Tailwind for structural, asymmetrical grids rather than rigid Shadcn cards.
Inject a global noise/grain texture using a fixed full-screen SVG overlay with pointer-events-none.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) where appropriate (like headers), but never purely transparent overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add .App { text-align: center; } in the css file.
Always use modern button styles (in this case, sharp editorial rectangles or distinct pill-shapes).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use proper icon libraries.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Use sonner for toasts. Sonner component are located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.tsx
